Republicans have a choice to stop catering to Trump and end this deeply unpopular war. They must vote yes.

Donald Trump thinks the federal government is his personal slush fund.

Nearly 2 BILLION dollars for his MAGA slush fund, a billion more for his gilded ballroom, and NOT ONE serious plan to lower costs for the families forced to pay the bill.

Democrats are fighting to lower costs. Republicans are fighting to launder Trump’s corruption through the federal budget. That’s the difference.

Trump is doing more for Russia’s war machine and Putin’s profits than he is for the American people struggling with soaring gas prices.

Putin remains one of the biggest winners in Trump’s costly, reckless, and illegal war with Iran.

As Trump’s DOL moves to rip away critical overtime protections for millions of workers, I am co-leading a bill to undo that damage and instead expand overtime for hardworking Americans.

The Restoring Overtime Pay Act expands and strengthens overtime protections, putting more money in the pockets of almost 30 million workers by gradually increasing the overtime salary threshold.

Congress must pass this bill immediately to ensure that American workers get the compensation they have earned.
